title: Generic vector generator silently erases most SCHC compression corpus
description: generate.py advertises schc_compression.json as a regenerable target, but schc_vectors() emits only 7 basic cases while the committed file has 34 including Rule7 canonicality/address/size and malformed cases. Running the documented single-file command overwrites and deletes 27 security/interoperability vectors. Remove this file from the write registry (while retaining the helper used by l2 vectors) unless a complete independent 34-case builder is provided; add a regression proving the unsafe target is rejected and the canonical file remains untouched.
notes: Also update stale README/test_vectors guidance: bare generate.py now refuses writes, and schc_compression.json is curated/not emitted. Regeneration docs must name an individual supported file or explicit --all confirmation.
